text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Shakur-kun! I hear it's your 
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I haven't said anything yet, though?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I bet you brought another stupid piece of 
junk, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've told you a hundred times, I have no 
intention of becoming your guinea pig.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How hurtful. When all I wish to do is 
purely celebrate your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah? What part of you could possibly be 
considered "pure"?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... If you're going that far, I 
suppose I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to show you just how much 
sincerity and devotion went into preparing 
this gift!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Introducing the new drug: "Dreamland 
Tapper"! While giving your mind rest, only 
your body keeps working, letting you use 
your PC as much as you want in your sleep—
